# Task 1: Slate Health Check

## Introduction

## Data Preparation

```{r}
#| label: task1-setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 11))

focus_genres <- c(
  "Action", "Comedy", "Drama",
  "Horror", "Animation"
)

movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv",
                   show_col_types = FALSE)

movies_clean <- movies |>
  filter(!is.na(release_year),
         release_year <= 2016) |>
  mutate(
    budget = if_else(budget < 10000, NA_real_, 
                     as.numeric(budget)),
    revenue = if_else(revenue <= 0, NA_real_,
                      as.numeric(revenue)),
    roi = if_else(
      !is.na(budget) & !is.na(revenue),
      revenue / budget,
      NA_real_
    ),
    budget_m = budget / 1e6,
    franchise_status = factor(
      franchise_status,
      levels = c("Original", "Franchise")
    )
  )

movies_focus <- movies_clean |>
  filter(primary_genre %in% focus_genres)
```

## Data Quality Assessment

```{r}
#| label: task1-data-quality

data_quality <- tibble(
  Measure = c(
    "Films in original dataset",
    "Films in analysis period",
    "Missing or invalid budgets",
    "Missing or invalid revenues",
    "Missing ROI values",
    "Films with valid budget and ROI"
  ),
  Count = c(
    nrow(movies),
    nrow(movies_clean),
    sum(is.na(movies_clean$budget)),
    sum(is.na(movies_clean$revenue)),
    sum(is.na(movies_clean$roi)),
    sum(complete.cases(
      movies_clean[, c("budget", "roi")]
    ))
  )
)

kable(data_quality, caption = "Data quality summary")
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r}
#| label: task1-summary-table

financial_summary <- tibble(
  Variable = c("Production budget ($m)", "ROI (multiple)"),
  N = c(
    sum(!is.na(movies_clean$budget)),
    sum(!is.na(movies_clean$roi))
  ),
  Mean = c(
    mean(movies_clean$budget_m, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(movies_clean$roi, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  Median = c(
    median(movies_clean$budget_m, na.rm = TRUE),
    median(movies_clean$roi, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  SD = c(
    sd(movies_clean$budget_m, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd(movies_clean$roi, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  Q1 = c(
    quantile(movies_clean$budget_m, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    quantile(movies_clean$roi, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  Q3 = c(
    quantile(movies_clean$budget_m, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    quantile(movies_clean$roi, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    across(Mean:Q3, ~round(.x, 2))
  )

knitr::kable(
  financial_summary,
  caption = "Summary statistics for production budgets and ROI"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: task1-franchise-summary

franchise_summary <- movies_clean |>
  count(franchise_status, name = "Films") |>
  mutate(
    Percentage = round(100 * Films / sum(Films), 1)
  )

kable(
  franchise_summary,
  caption = "Franchise and Original film composition"
)
```

## Overall Budget Distribution

```{r}
#| label: fig-budget-distribution
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of reported production budgets."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

ggplot(
  movies_clean |> filter(!is.na(budget_m)),
  aes(x = budget_m)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 45,
    fill = "#3478A8",
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_dollar(suffix = "m")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Production budget (USD millions)",
    y = "Number of films"
  )
```

## Overall ROI Distribution

```{r}
#| label: fig-roi-distribution
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of ROI on a logarithmic scale."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

ggplot(
  movies_clean |> filter(!is.na(roi), roi > 0),
  aes(x = roi)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 45,
    fill = "#269C8C",
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "firebrick"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    labels = scales::label_number()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "ROI (revenue / budget, log scale)",
    y = "Number of films"
  )
```

## Franchise Composition

```{r}
#| label: fig-franchise-composition
#| fig-cap: "Proportion of Franchise and Original films."
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4

ggplot(
  franchise_summary,
  aes(x = franchise_status,
      y = Films,
      fill = franchise_status)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(Percentage, "%")),
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Original" = "#3478A8",
               "Franchise" = "#E59B46")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Film classification",
    y = "Number of films"
  ) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  expand_limits(y = max(franchise_summary$Films) * 1.1)
```

## Production Budgets Across Genres

```{r}
#| label: fig-budget-genre
#| fig-cap: "Production budget distributions across the five focus genres."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

ggplot(
  movies_focus |> filter(!is.na(budget_m)),
  aes(
    x = reorder(primary_genre, budget_m,
                FUN = median),
    y = budget_m,
    fill = primary_genre
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.alpha = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_dollar(suffix = "m")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Primary genre",
    y = "Production budget (USD millions)"
  )
```
